data.exact_reserve_text: During 2020 the syndicate released prior year reserves of $75.1m (2019: $15.9m). Specialty lines and cyber & executive risk had releases of $37.5m and $7.0m respectively. Both specialty lines and cyber & executive risk have been impacted over the past few years by the increased claims seen on their liability books resulting in decreased releases. Action taken in the Marine division to remediate selected areas of the account, including the UK Marine portfolio in January 2020, have resulted in a release of $8.6m in the division. Both the property and reinsurance divisions have benefitted from releases on some of the 2019 natural catastrophe events, namely Storm Dorian in the US and Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai in Japan. The claims impact of the COVID-19 global pandemic is not included in the prior year reserve movements.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a prior-year reserve release of $75.1m in 2020 (2019: $15.9m). The release was driven by favourable claims development and management remediation actions, notably releases in Specialty lines ($37.5m), Cyber & executive risk ($7.0m) and Marine remediation ($8.6m), together with reserve releases relating to certain 2019 natural catastrophe events (Storm Dorian, Typhoon Hagibis and Typhoon Faxai). The report states COVID-19 impacts have been excluded from prior year reserve movements.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, gross) as at 1 Jan 2020 (prior-year comparative). Prior year development extracted from Managing Agent narrative 'During 2020 the syndicate released prior year reserves of $75.1m' (explicit figure) - the report does not present a labeled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross-only line; the narrative appears to be the syndicate's stated prior-year reserve movement. Amounts are reported in the native currency (USD). A gross claims development triangle exists in the Technical Provisions note but was not fully parsed into a detailed cell-by-cell triangle for this extraction; therefore the triangle was not used to recalculate prior-year development.

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development table (percent and amount rows) appears in the Technical Provisions note (page 15). Due to ambiguity in aligning the printed rows/columns in the provided text extract, the cell-level development rows have not been reconstructed here. The presence of a development table is noted; a full cell-level extraction would reduce uncertainty and could be used to cross-check prior year development.
